attempted_claim: Fix degree d=7, genus g=2, one-part double Hurwitz data: mu=(7) over 0, nu=(3,2,1,1) over infinity, plus r=2g-2+l(mu)+l(nu)=2+1+4=7 simple branch points at fixed distinct ordered points of P1(C). Let H be the connected one-part double Hurwitz number (sum of 1/|Aut(f)| fixing the branch locus pointwise, equivalently S7 transitive-tuple class-algebra count divided by 7!). The profile nu has 4 parts, outside the Goulden-Jackson-Vakil Faber-Hurwitz analysis restricted to at most 3 parts over infinity, and no closed intersection value at (g,d,nu)=(2,7,(3,2,1,1)) is tabulated. Prove or disprove, with two independently certified logs, the Do-Lewanski ELSV-type equality instance at this profile: (i) the Goulden-Jackson-Vakil character/sinh-side exact value of H via the S7 class-algebra sum, and (ii) the Do-Lewanski Hodge/Chiodo-class intersection-side evaluation over the corresponding moduli space computed via an independent intersection-theory pipeline (e.g. admcycles/topological recursion), with all Hodge integrals listed. Equality (a first explicit 4-part genus-2 confirmation yielding a new closed Hodge-integral value) and certified inequality (a rigorous bound on the formula's scope, with both logs archived) are each a complete resolution; no exhaustive tuple enumeration is claimed.
claim_type: two-sided test of Do-Lewanski ELSV-type equality at a 4-part genus-2 one-part profile
decisive_failure: Route (ii), the independent JPPZ Chiodo-class intersection evaluation, reached only the 0- through 3-edge stable-graph stages (partial sum 18897.14162179 vs target 16013.33611111); the 4-edge (4409 graphs) and 5-edge stages were not completed in the time budget, so the equality is unproven. A Ch^{[x]} scaling error (X vs X^m) was found and corrected mid-pass; all archived stage logs reflect the corrected scaling. No admcycles/topological-recursion pipeline was available in this environment, so the intersection side rests on the from-scratch JPPZ+DVI implementation.
